findings.evidence: Lines 178–182 take `(n : ℕ)` and return only `ContDiffAt ℝ (n + 1) γ p₀`; the only extension theorem is likewise finite-order at `FiniteDimension.lean:34–37`, while roadmap lines 80–84 and 237–240 require a `C∞` smooth exponential, and no solution-family uniqueness theorem exists in this file.
findings.fix: Generalize the bump-extension and Picard-solution theorems to extended differentiability orders, or add a `C∞` specialization returning one fixed `γ` with `ContDiffAt ℝ ∞`; do not leave assembly dependent on unproved uniqueness/compatibility.
findings.issue: `exists_contDiffAt_picard_solution` quantifies finite order before `∃ γ`, so different orders may yield different families and consumers cannot derive one `ContDiffAt ℝ ∞` solution germ.

summary: The public API does not produce the single infinitely smooth solution family required by the roadmap.
